confirmedFacts: Ethan Miller is a fictional American Counter-Strike coach known as Trace.
He is Head Coach of Kairos Counter-Strike Academy.
He is a former American regional Counter-Strike player.
He originally expected to become an assistant coach.
He was instead appointed Head Coach of the Academy.
He is a pupil of Lukas "Luk" Novak.
Kairos is developing him as a future elite coach.
He prepares academy players for progression to the main team.
His first confirmed appearance is Episode 25.
He continues evaluating Caleb Mercer and serves as Caleb's tactical mentor.
He participates in Cameron Ruiz's evaluation.
He conducts the first tactical workshops with Caleb Mercer, Owen Fletcher, and Emiliano Navarro.
He prioritizes communication, teamwork, and adaptability in non-mechanical evaluations.
He oversees the first internal Kairos Counter-Strike scrim.
He conducts the Episode 51 strategic pressure exercise without running a scrim.
He participates in the November 7 Kairos community vote.
